entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • StartDebuggingSessionAsync does not hydrate source texts of additional and analyzer config documents #80687
  • 21 VB NoPia tests fail locally with "[HRESULT 0x8007000B] - An attempt was made to load a program with an incorrect format." #80686
  • Fix the SafeContext of Span-valued collection expressions to match specification #80683
  • Parameter `escapeFrom` in `CheckValEscape()`/`CheckRefEscape()` is confusing #80682
  • Hiccup causes "Computing Rename Information" tooltip to be stuck #80679

Closed

  • IsSymbolAccessibleWithin does not consider EmbeddedAttribute #80680
  • Support the 'language' attribute for <code> documentation elements #39154
    Backlog
  • support syntax highlighting for code documentation comments #75181
  • Xml tags are not getting classified properly #13843
    Backlog
  • 'Add parameter' to primary constructor doesn't assign the property it was added for #80564
    Backlog
  • Style: Decrease number of lines for default <summary> element in XML comments #10968
    Backlog
  • "Go to Definition" sometimes opens plain text disassembly with no syntax highlighting #80329
    18.0
  • IDE0200 is suggested for delegates with incompatible Task<T> nullability causing CS8621 warning #79000
    Backlog
  • Suggest name when naming tuple element #75347
    Backlog
  • Deconstructed local variable isn't underlined if it's reassigned exactly once in a local function #76570
    Backlog
  • Go To Definition should not require tool window to decide between user code and generated code #77895
    Backlog
  • Exception is thrown in SyntaxEditor when adding a delegate declaration to an interface declaration #78860
    Backlog
  • Renaming type parameter as type argument of operator-returned generic type fails #80580
    Backlog
  • "Add File Header" codefix priority too high #80663
  • Unsafe context required on an explicit interface implementation with pointers in the interface type parameters despite being marked unsafe #80565
    18.3
  • Cleanup after https://devdiv.visualstudio.com/DevDiv/_workitems/edit/2441480 is fixed #78050
    18.0
  • CS7036 error for a parameter 'original' that does not exist in my record. #80661
    Backlog
  • Improve diagnostic quality for less accessible base type argument #40977
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Avoid deep recursion in PatternExplainer.VisitPathsToNode #80685
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix SafeContext of Span-valued collection expressions to match specification #80684
  • Fix IsSymbolAccessibleWithin to respect EmbeddedAttribute #80681
  • [release/dev18.0] Build BuildHost against net8.0 #80678
    Needs Shiproom Approval
  • Fix trailing whitespace after $selected$ in snippet expansion #80676

Merged

  • Handle potential null in extension lookup #80621
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Next
  • Extend `ToArray` optimization when targeting read-only collection types #80104
    Area-Compilers, Community, Code Gen Quality, Next
  • Add syntax highlighting for C# code in documentation comment `<code>` blocks #80672
    VSCode, Next
  • Add IDE/Compiler specific custom instructions #80617
    Next
  • Fix 'Add parameter' refactoring to assign property/field for primary constructors #80655
    VSCode, Next
  • Add options to generate XML documentation comments on a single line and control tag generation #80664
    Needs UX Triage, VSCode, Next
  • Fix invalid workspace state when decompilation cancelled. #80643
    VSCode
  • Fix IDE0200: Don't suggest lambda-to-method-group conversion with nullability mismatches #80667
    VSCode, Next
  • Update formatting and add PROTOTYPE comments note in copilot-instructions #80677
    Next
  • Port 80643 to main #80652
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Fix exception when adding delegate declaration to interface in SyntaxEditor #80668
    VSCode, Next
  • Suggest name when naming incomplete tuple element #80671
    VSCode
  • Fix deconstructed local variables not being underlined when reassigned in local functions #80670
    VSCode, Next
  • Go To Definition: Automatically navigate to user code when multiple locations include generated code #80669
    Next
  • Fix FindReferences with a type arg in a conversion operator #80666
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Fix "Add File Header" code fix priority to prevent interference with "Remove unnecessary usings" #80665
    VSCode, Next
  • Use proper "unsafe" context while binding type in explicit interface specifier #80610
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Fix stack overflow when looking for json embedded strings in a file #80675
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Restore fully qualify for Razor #80674
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Improve diagnostic quality for less accessible base type argument #80483
    Area-Compilers, Community, Next

Updated

  • Add limited support for binarylogger to MSBuildWorkspace #80120
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Add support for with(...) elements in collection expressions (3). #80568
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Improve detection of invalid references for implicitly typed expression variables declared within implicit object creation expressions. #80546
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Target-Typed New
  • Add a test for collection expression with ref struct element type #80593
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix ref safe context of assignments to be their RHS #80633
    Area-Compilers
  • Use core compiler on netfx hosts with toolset package #80631
    Area-Compilers
  • Extensions: Add ReduceExtensionMember API #80659
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Extensions: fix betterness with params #80531
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Optimize CopyRefAssembly task by checking file size and timestamp before MVID extraction #80635
